facts.fact: Starlink received approval to operate in Zimbabwe in 2024 and serves homes, businesses, farms and schools; its traffic, classed as VSAT in regulatory statistics, rose from 117.83 to 168.21 petabytes between Q3 and Q4 2025, and VSAT subscriptions rose over 31% to 67,057 (the article does not name the publishing regulator; article date used for the figures' period end, Q4 2025).
